# ZA Collectibles

ZA Collectibles is a Cape Town heritage and collectibles house. The site covers appraisal, research and provenance, buying, consignment, auctions, private sourcing, collection building, presentation and preservation, and collecting knowledge.

## Primary sections
- /appraisals.html — appraisal and evaluation
- /for-sale.html — current curation / items for sale
- /auctions.html — auctions and specialist sales
- /services.html — service families
- /disciplines.html — collecting disciplines
- /recent-work.html — recent projects and gallery
- /knowledge.html — knowledge centre and specialist editorial
- /about.html — organisation and operating history
- /trust.html — trust, standards and accreditation
- /contact.html — contact and enquiries

The production domain will replace the GitHub staging URL before public launch.
